audioDescription: Silent. No music, voiceover or sound effects.
limitations: Illustrative procedural heat: the GLSL field is authored (blurred-mask interior falloff, Gaussian hotspots, thinness cooling at nose/ear, seeded value-noise shimmer from uTime), not a physical thermal simulation or measured data; no scale, degrees or legend is shown.
Canvas 2D is used only once at load to rasterize the silhouette and wire masks into Three.js CanvasTextures; chroma.js only precomputes the 4-stop LAB ramp DataTexture.
Interior falloff is approximated by 12px/46px Canvas blur passes of the hard mask rather than a true distance transform.
Network heat spreads along a horizontal coordinate baked into the wire mask, approximating path-length propagation.
ColorManagement is disabled and renderer.outputColorSpace is LinearSRGBColorSpace so sRGB ramp bytes are written without double gamma correction.
Three.js 0.186 is vendored locally as three.min.js (esbuild IIFE global THREE from node_modules/three); requires WebGL in the rendering browser.
Preview only: alternate paper/red scenes of the full video are not included.
